tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. The warm cream of the profile mark; use behind every publication and screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, product windows and inputs sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-mist
tokens.usage: Soft sky field behind product photos and calm feature sections.

tokens.name: surface-sage
tokens.usage: Reassurance panels (delivery, wholesale, care notes).

tokens.name: surface-sand
tokens.usage: Warm quiet band for footers and secondary sections.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface, surface-raised, surface-mist, surface-sage and surface-sand.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, specs and helper text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: The logo blue. Large shapes, discs and dividers only, never text under 24px and never behind white text.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and contact bars. Carries on-brand-deep text.

tokens.name: on-brand-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-deep.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text, links and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-mist.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Soft green shapes and discs. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Green text and check icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sage.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Out of stock or error text on surface and surface-raised. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and ghost buttons (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px solid with a 3px offset, on every surface.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero line on banners and covers. One per piece.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small uppercase tags such as PRODUCT SPECS.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, list items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap and small card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on posts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections. Leave air; calm needs room.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Outer margin on banners and print.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Product cards and post frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and contact bars.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Barely there.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered or selected cards.
